messages:
sophia: Heads up — p99 for prod m-chat-13b jumped from ~420ms to ~1.8s right after the canary autotune flip at ~12:03. p50 is fine.
sophia: grafana -> https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/abc123/m-chat-overview?orgId=1 :eyes:
deploy-bot: Canary 03 deploy completed at 2026-03-18T12:02:58Z. Changed config: `runtime.autotune=true`, `selector.mode=adaptive-density`.
mike: I'm looking. Quick hypothesis: autotune changed microbatch selection heuristics to favor denser batches which increased queueing for small-sequence traffic, causing tail escalation.
julia: grabbed a short profile of canary-03 nodes, posting microbatch distribution + tail samples:
```
microbatch_size,p50_ms,p95_ms,p99_ms,count
1,120,260,430,42000
2,130,290,520,18000
3,150,350,720,8000
4,200,480,980,3000
5,260,740,1400,700
6,310,1200,1800,120
7,400,1600,2300,40
```
julia: note how p99 shoots up starting at size 5-6. Also saw longer kernel invocation times for those larger microbatches.
ran: KV cache metrics on canary-03 look off — hit rate fell from ~92% to ~61% after the autotune flip. Prefetch thresholds were lowered by the new policy (more aggressive batching -> less effective KV reuse)
sophia: ok ops, can we roll the config back on the canary first? want to confirm mitigation before full roll
ops-oncall: rolling back autotune on canary-03 now. Command: `redwoodctl config set runtime.autotune=false --scope=canary-03 && redwoodctl deploy-config canary-03`
ops-oncall: (running) :hammer:
infra-bot: canary-03 config change applied at 2026-03-18T12:03:42Z. Observing metrics...
infra-bot: p99 trending down — 12:03:55 p99=1.2s, 12:04:10 p99=540ms, 12:04:30 p99=430ms. Rollback appears effective. :white_check_mark:
mike: looks like kernel autoselect picked a slower execution path for quantized kernels at microbatch >=6. With KV hit rate dropping, effective per-request work increased and queueing cascaded.
julia: filed follow-up ticket RW-9876 to add guardrails: 
- cap auto-selected microbatch for small-seq traffic to <=4
- prefer KV-friendly kernel variants when cache hit rate < 80%
- expose a rollbackable feature-flag for autotune flips
Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-9876
sophia: thanks team. We'll keep the canary reverted and schedule a controlled bake with telemetry on microbatch+cache interplay. Please paste any additional profiling artifacts here.
mike: adding perf dump from kernel-selector for the canary run to the ticket. :rocket:
sophia: closing this incident thread but leaving it for postmortem comments. Good rapid response everyone. :thumbsup:
